concept.title: Defogging the inside of the windshield

keywords.indexterm: windshield defrosting and defogging defogging the inside of the windshield

section.title: For manual climate control system
section.p: To defog the inside of the windshield using the manual climate control system, follow these steps:

li.p: Select any fan speed other than 0.
External airflow and air conditioning (A/C) will be selected automatically.

section.p: If external airflow and A/C are not selected automatically, manually press the corresponding control buttons.

section.title: For automatic climate control system
section.p: To defog the inside of the windshield using the automatic climate control system, follow these steps:

li.p: External airflow is selected automatically, and the air conditioner (A/C) operates according to the detected ambient temperature.

section.p: If external airflow and A/C are not selected automatically, manually press the corresponding control icons. If you select the mode, a slower fan speed is adjusted to a higher fan speed.
